# Routes that enter /openapi.json with a path, a method and NO BODY.
#
# THIS LIST MAY ONLY SHRINK. It is the same instrument as
# internal/arch/testdata/turkish_ledger.txt and for the same reason: a debt too
# large to pay in one commit, that must never grow while it is being paid.
#
# TestEveryRealRouteIsDescribed enforces both directions. A route that is
# undescribed and NOT on this list fails the test as new debt. A route that IS
# on this list and has since been described also fails it, because a paid line
# that stays behind quietly forgives the next one.
#
# Opened 2026-09-07 at THIRTY-EIGHT, the day core/openapi was published (ADR
# 0035) and the question could be asked at all. Two remain.
#
# What the thirty-six were, because the shape is worth keeping:
#
#   - TWENTY-FIVE were ONE root cause, diagnosed four times independently by
#     four modules that all reached the same conclusion — customer against cart
#     on "Address", payment against product on "Collection", fulfillment against
#     product on "Option", order against cart on "LineItem". A component's name
#     came from the Go type name alone, so two modules could not both own a type
#     called Address, and a name clash does not degrade one endpoint: the
#     document FAILS to build and /openapi.json returns 500 for EVERY module.
#     All four chose bodiless endpoints over taking the schema down, all four
#     wrote that the fix belonged in the core, and all four were right. ADR 0036
#     gave the component name a namespace — the module being described — and no
#     type in any of the four modules was renamed.
#
#   - FIVE were order after-sales routes with no reason on file, and they were
#     worse than unexplained: order/api's Describe godoc named five undescribed
#     endpoints under the heading "There is NO other undescribed endpoint" while
#     these five sat outside it, added after the sentence was written, with
#     nothing in the repository able to contradict it.
#
#   - SIX were the webhook plugin's operator surface, which needed its responses
#     TYPED before they could be described.
#
# WHAT IS LEFT, and it is not a schema problem
#
# The search plugin's two endpoints. Describing them means naming this
# package's types from a describe function, and plugins/searchpg is still
# written in Turkish (twelve files on the language ledger). ADR 0012's ratchet
# says a new file is English and the ledger may only shrink, so the honest way
# to pay these two is to translate the package rather than to write an English
# file that names listeZarfi and tekilZarf. That is a translation task, and it
# is tracked as one.
GET /store/v1/search
POST /admin/v1/search/reindex
